faq_heading: Homes near Lynn Fripps Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Lynn Fripps Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Lynn Fripps Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Lynn Fripps Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Lynn Fripps Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Alex Hope Elementary (0.6 km north-east), Willoughby Elementary (0.8 km south-west) and Yorkson Creek Middle School (0.8 km north-west).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Lynn Fripps Elementary

17 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Lynn Fripps Elementary in a straight line (12 elementary, 2 middle, 2 secondary, 1 other; 1 independent). The closest is Alex Hope Elementary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is R C Garnett Demonstration Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Walnut Grove Secondary (1.5 km); the nearest independent school is The King's School (1.8 km). Other elementary schools close by: Alex Hope Elementary (0.6 km north-east), Willoughby Elementary (0.8 km south-west), Richard Bulpitt Elementary (0.9 km south), Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary (1.3 km south-west), des Voyageurs (1.6 km north-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-5) is Willoughby Elementary, 0.8 km south-west of Lynn Fripps Elementary.
